facts: Pretoria is the executive capital and hosts all foreign embassies
Cape Town is the legislative capital, Bloemfontein the judicial capital
worth_knowing: Cape Town, the country's oldest city, is the seat of Parliament. The Constitutional Court, the highest court, has been in Johannesburg since 1994, not in Bloemfontein.
